verdict.rationale: v0 publishes a documented Platform API (v0.app/docs/api/platform) offering programmatic access to chat creation, project management, and code generation, backed by an official SDK (v0-sdk on GitHub) with concrete usage examples like v0.chats.create() and streaming responses. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of the API's completeness and reliability beyond first-party docs and SDK snippets.
